# Setup guide

## Build the search index

Run `make index` from the repository root.

## Search flags

The index is searched with ripgrep. For its flags, run `rg --help` or read the [ripgrep guide](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/blob/master/GUIDE.md).

## What the triage bot does

The triage bot manages issue hygiene, for example adding labels or closing stale issues (examples, not a fixed list).

## Known CI failure

On our CI runners the first build fails with `EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/cache'`. Set `CACHE_DIR=$RUNNER_TEMP/cache` before building.
